notes.content: Minimum grade of c- in major courses
Students must earn a minimum grade of C- in all courses taken to fulfill the major requirements; and must earn a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 in the major.

notes.content: Students in the Rangeland Resource Science B.S. program have additional upper division course options and requirements as outlined in the university catalog. Students will also complete one emphasis area in: Botany, Ecological Restoration, Geospatial Technology, Fire, Natural Resource Policy, or Soils, or any combination of advisor approved electives. Where there is a note “Only lower division courses listed," alternative course options exist at the upper-division level. Review the University Catalog for full details.
